TEXT: A certain day in Akihabara.
The maid cafe, "Pretty Garden Chapter 10".

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI_KAORI
TEXT: Ladies and gentlemen!

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Now then, we truly thank you for attending our 
"Pretty Garden" and...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
"Otaku Girls Unite" collaboration offline meetup. 
Welcome one and all.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Once again, I am the organizer, Saori Bajeena.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Also an organizer, Makishima Kaori.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Well now, I didn't think we would have this many 
people participating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
Contrary to what I thought, this has become a 
large-scale party.

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT:
It looks like there are other circles doing offline 
meetups, so do your best not to cause trouble for 
the other customers.

SPEAKER: SPK_EVERYBODY
TEXT: Kay~~

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: Alright.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
Now we have a message from the head maid, 
Kirara-san of "Pretty Garden Chapter 10", who has 
let us use her amazing venue.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
Everyone~, I'm Hoshino Kirara♪ Welcome to the 
10th opening of this store.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
We have prepared a lot of tasty food, various 
drinks, and cute maids so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: Please enjoy yourself☆

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_GIRLS
TEXT: Uhyoooooo!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT:
If you enjoy my cafe, you can always review it on 
a blog or something, y'know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KAORI
TEXT: You're doing well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRARA
TEXT: I am the head maid, after all☆

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...She's the same as ever.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Doesn't seem to have aged one bit.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
And you, you turned out to be rather beautiful in 
the time I haven't seen you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Huh? What... Are you an idiot? Don't make a pass at 
your sister at an offline meetup.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
I'm not making a pass at you. I'm just 
complimenting how you look more like an adult.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Yeah yeah, siscon, siscon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
And besides, why don't you go telling your opinions 
about appearance to that witch over there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my... You mean me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Of course! What's with that getup!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
What do you mean? You know this well, the "Queen 
of Nightmare" costume.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...It's been a while since I wore this. How is it? Do I 
look better in it than I did before?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Yeah, it fits you well, almost like the real thing. But 
it's about 100 times more painful to look at.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Either way, stop cosplaying at your age!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's fine... It's fitting after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
*sigh* ...Looks aside, your sure haven't changed at 
all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Fufu... You as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: The one who's changed the most is probably you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Me? You think so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Yeah yeah, right now you are a capable company 
president, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Don't tease me like that. It's not that special.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I heard from Saori that you've been working hard.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
The only thing special is the title. I still have a long 
way to go.
Yes, now I am no longer Kousaka Kyousuke...

I joined the Makishimas and took on the name of 
Makishima Kyousuke.
Also...

SPEAKER: SPK_UNKNOWN_2
TEXT: Father.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, what's up, Tomoka?
I have a cute daughter.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: Mother seems really happy, doesn't she?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Yeah.

All of her otaku friends have gathered and are 
merry.
It's a scene filled with fun and enjoyment.

What she previously wanted, and became 
desperate for, has piled up, and the results are 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT: Hello...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Ah, Kurara-san! I'm really looking forward to the 
Meruru remake!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT: Ah! Really?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURARA
TEXT:
All the old staff have gotten together and are 
working their hardest, so please look forward to it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I will!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Yamanashi-sensei, when will you do the maschera 
remake?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Eh!? Ummmm... C-Can you wait until your next life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I... will wait an eternity if I need to...

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: ...The fans' love... is heavy...

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Kyousuke-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm sorry for leaving you with Tomo.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's fine, no worries. There are a lot of people you 
haven't seen in a while, right? Go talk to them all.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: That's right, please do not worry about us, Mother.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: See?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: ...Thank you, Kyousuke-san, Tomo-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_TOMOKA
TEXT: Ehehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Hey, Kirino. Looking at this child, it's certain there 
exists a way to keep one's memories of their past 
life after reincarnating.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
As expected of Saori's daughter... Tomo-chan's 
mental age and communication level are way past 
a five year-old's.

Then, Kanata, who was entangled by Kuroneko 
earlier, casually sneaked over to us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Hey hey, Saori-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ah, Kanata-san. Are you enjoying yourself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Of course. Even now I'm enjoying having passionate 
discussions with my fans.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: That sounds great.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT:
Hey, there has been something I've been curious 
about for a while, but can I ask?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: What happened to my glasses?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Ah, that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I gave them away, quite some time ago.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: I'm... not sure who has them now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KANATA
TEXT: Then, that's fine.
Kanata smiled with satisfaction.

Yes... Saori no longer needs to use those magic 
glasses.
As of now, she no longer needs them.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Oh, that offline meetup is getting pumped.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: Yes, we can't lose to them.
Those glasses are surely continuing to give-

SPEAKER: SPK_GIRL
TEXT:
Now! Everyone! Let us begin our first offline 
meetup!
-that first step of courage to someone out there.
